## How the revert was done
Two shell commands that swapped in the old file (a `git checkout` of 5004e92's `order.js`, and a throwaway copy outside the worktree) were declined. I made the temporary one-line revert with the Edit tool instead, ran the tests, and edited it straight back.

## Scope
- **Working tree:** `git status --short` and `git diff HEAD` are both empty after the restore, and no temporary files were left behind.
- **Diff from 5004e92 to HEAD:** only `src/telemetry/order.js`, `src/telemetry/order.test.js` and the new `src/telemetry/state.test.js`.
